theme.primary_archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST
theme.tone: Academic, authoritative, community-centered, warm, premium, official university platform

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-50 leading-tight
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
rules.small_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800/50 inline-block mb-3

rules.tinted_grey: Never use #000000 or plain gray. Always tint neutrals with slate/navy (#0F172A) or emerald tone.
rules.cta_buttons: Use primary emerald (#064E3B or hover #047857) or gold accent (#D97706) for primary CTAs.
rules.overlay_opacity: Hero overlay must be maximum bg-slate-950/50 or bg-emerald-950/60 to let photography shine.

surface_styles.name: Academic Crystal Glass
surface_styles.css: bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-emerald-900/10 dark:border-white/10 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/5

surface_styles.name: Gold Crest Highlight Card
surface_styles.css: bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-slate-50 to-amber-50/30 dark:from-slate-900 dark:via-slate-900 dark:to-emerald-950/30 border-l-4 border-amber-500 shadow-md

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays on dark surfaces, soft radial gold glows (#F59E0B) behind hero stats.

grids.team_grid: Exact 15 member layout: Row 1 (2 leader cards - standard/large), Row 2 (4 coordinator cards), Row 3 (4 division lead cards), Row 4 (5 member cards).

layouts.header: Sticky glassmorphic navbar with logo (UIN Gusdur KKN-PLP Group 66), live navigation links, quick access jump menu, light/dark theme toggle, and Admin Portal CTA.
layouts.hero: Split/Asymmetric hero with high impact typography, official university tag ('UIN K.H. Abdurrahman Wahid Pekalongan - 2026'), tagline 'Be Present. Learn. Serve.', action CTAs ('Explore Our Journey' and 'Meet the Team'), and live stats badge.
layouts.team: Structured 15-member hierarchy layout in 2 / 4 / 4 / 5 row grouping with detailed modal view for each student.
layouts.timeline: 7-stage vertical interactive timeline with phase badges, key deliverables, and community impact indicators.
layouts.gallery: Category filterable grid (All, Community, Teaching, Infrastructure, Social, Cultural) with full lightbox modal and keyboard navigation.
layouts.news: Grid with featured article spotlight, search, topic filter tags, and reading modal view.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Team Members, Programs, Gallery, News, Timeline, Archives, Videos, Memories, Location, Settings, Activity Logs, Logout) with full CRUD tables, form dialogs, image dropzone mock, search/filter, and system activity logs.

motion.scroll_behavior: Smooth scroll with active section link highlighting.

animations.counters: Animated statistical count-up triggers when entering view.
animations.modal_fade: initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text). Focus outlines always enabled.
accessibility.data_testid_policy: All buttons, links, search inputs, tabs, filter buttons, modals, and CRUD actions MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use lightweight SVG patterns, Framer Motion staggered cards, and Lucide react dynamic icons to ensure lightning fast load times.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 15 team members are rendered in the exact specified grouping: Row 1 = 2 members, Row 2 = 4 members, Row 3 = 4 members, Row 4 = 5 members.
Keep emerald green (#064E3B) and deep navy (#0F172A) with gold accents (#D97706) as core primary identity.
Implement both the public single page experience and the fully functional CMS Admin Dashboard with sidebar navigation.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, and interactive elements include explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Provide modal dialogs for item details in Team, Programs, News, Gallery, Archives, and Admin CRUD operations.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default plain centered layouts or generic AI slop styling.
Never use pure black #000000 or plain gray. Always use tinted slate or emerald neutrals.
Every interactive element must have clear hover, active, and focus states with high contrast.
Do not use emojis for core action icons. Always use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Ensure generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to create breathing space in all components.
